whatsappMessage:
Hi Tasty Kitchen,

I noticed your restaurant has amazing 4.5★ reviews from over 2,200 customers in Saguna More, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and online table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur popular dishes showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/tastykitchen

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Tasty Kitchen team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Tasty Kitchen) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and online reservation features for your Saguna More location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, prices, aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
